description: I fought against LGBT lifestyles being promoted by public schools/institutions. In my first session (2023), I wrote “The Given Name Act” (HB1468/Act542). This new law protects the religious liberty of students, teachers, and professors; now they cannot be forced to call students by their “preferred pronouns.” It also gives parents the right to sue the school if the district tries to hide the fact that a child is involved in this activity while at school.
